[RDSC.3.10] `fault_fact_sites` (field 14) is the program's fault-fact site
count ([LERR.9.10]). The compiler **must** compute it from the rule network and
write it in every artefact, `0` where the network has no site. A runtime that
pre-sizes its working memory sizes its fault-fact pool from it at load; any
other runtime **may** ignore it.
